CHOOSE YOUR WEAPON

Sword
Melee arc swing
Close-range swing that heals you on hit (the heal scales down as your absorb shield grows, so it can't snowball). Short cooldown, wide arc at higher levels. The Range buff does NOT affect this weapon. (Z) Blade Storm — unleashes 5-7 branching slashes, each a big-AoE crescent that lands on an enemy (they branch across the nearest foes, or all pile onto a lone boss). (X) Phantom Blades — a spectral sword materializes over EVERY enemy and sweeps through it for heavy damage, cascading across the horde.
Pinball
Bouncing projectile
Fires a heavy chrome ball that ricochets between enemies. Each bounce gains damage and +0.2% speed, snowballing as it bounces — but it fires slowly (low attack speed). Ability (Z): Frenzy — unleashes 8-14 auto-homing pinballs (each bounces up to 5 enemies).
Toxgun
Toxic minigun
A small handheld minigun spraying toxic rounds. Low hit damage, but each bullet stacks a poison DoT that ramps up fast (capped at 1000% of your DPS/sec).
Boomstick
Close-range pump-action
A small handheld pump-action boomstick. Fires a tight cone of pellets that hit brutally hard up close but fade fast at range, then racks the pump between shells. Ability (Z): Phoenix Payload — a blazing phoenix erupts out of the ground, circles overhead raining fire across a wide ring around you, then blazes away in a shower of embers. Ability (X): Combined Slug — a TOGGLE that fuses the whole spread into one heavy slug: much faster, far more damage, and it kicks you backwards.
Cryo-Shatter ❄
Freeze & shatter — crowd control
Fires fast piercing frost shards that chill enemies (slowing them). Enough chill FREEZES a non-boss enemy solid; the next shard SHATTERS it in a frost nova that damages and chills everything nearby — chain your freezes. (Z) Flash Freeze — freezes and damages every enemy on screen, shatters the already-frozen, and lobs a salvo of ice shards that rain down for extra damage and freezes. (X) Absolute Zero — you slow to a crawl while charging a colossal ice blast, then freeze EVERYTHING for 5 seconds (heavy bosses are only chilled); charges stack so you can layer several. (C) Glacier Lance — a colossal lance that drills through everything, freezing what it impales and erupting at the end. (V) Frozen Tomb — entombs the 8 nearest enemies in ice that all shatter together.
Engineer
Deployable turrets
Deploys auto-firing turrets that target nearby enemies for you.
Flamethrower
Pyroclasm — heat & burn-spread
A short-range stream of fire. The longer you hold it, the more it heats up — widening the cone and ramping damage. Enemies catch fire and spread the burn to others around them. The Range buff does NOT affect this weapon. Ability 1 (Z): Molotov Barrage — hurls a rapid volley of molotovs in every direction that burst in fiery, glass-shattering explosions and leave burning puddles. Ability 2 (X): Fire Pillars — a TOGGLE: while active it erupts a fresh burst of 5-7 big-AoE fire pillars on your nearest enemies every 1s (radius scales with Range) but drains 1% of your max HP per second (from your absorb shield first). Press again to turn it off.
Boomerang
Returning projectile
Throws a boomerang that travels out and returns, hitting enemies twice. Ability (Z): Circle Boomerang — hurls a full ring of boomerangs out in every direction that curve back through everything.
Pulse Modulator
Expanding shockwave
Releases an expanding ring of damage with only a light shove (knockback is now minimal). Ability 1 (Z): Implosion — for 6 seconds your pulses INVERT and drag enemies inward for 85% base damage. Ability 2 (X): Shockflash — summons 15 pulse blasts in quick succession from random points in a ring around you, halting mobs in place.
Tesla Coil
Chain lightning
Auto-zaps the nearest enemy, then arcs to several others nearby. Each jump does a little less damage. Great against tight packs. Ability 1 (Z): Overdrive — triples attack speed and range for a few seconds. Ability 2 (X): Shocking Tactic — infinite chaining for 7 seconds at 2% damage, 7.5% chance per zap to explode in a huge radius for 200% base damage. Must be purchased in the Inventory with Lunar Shards + Boss Essence. Ability 3 (C): Lightning Swarm — a TOGGLE that rains lightning bolts on random points around you (direct + small-AoE damage, chance to ignite) while draining 1% of your max HP per second. Press again to turn it off.
Time Element ⌛
Kronax's stolen moveset — a rare Kronax drop
Wields Kronax's time magic. Fires time-orbs that leave ticking clock pulses (the main attack's range is fixed — the Range buff does not affect it). Five abilities: Z Temporal Burst (7 branching temporal-tear slashes across enemies — all converge on a lone target) · X Clockburst · C Chronosphere · V Echo Swarm · G Destructive Rewind (snap back a few seconds and age every enemy with heavy damage). Abilities still scale with Range (at 1/5 efficiency). Obtained as a very rare (~0.75%) drop from defeating Kronax — no crafting required.
Galaxy Element 🌌
Blink, vortex and starfall
Wields raw cosmic force. Your main attack is a damaging BLINK — you tear across to your cursor, harming anything in the corridor you cross, and leave a small collapsing vortex where you land that drags nearby enemies in and grinds them. Five abilities: (Z) Galactic Blast — a heavy star-cored projectile with a wide detonation that shoves enemies back. (X) Homing Constellation — an aura blooms beneath you, three stars begin orbiting, and each peels off to seek a target and burst; every star that leaves is replaced, and recasting STACKS up to five rings. (C) Gamma Burst — 25 spinning vortexes tear open, each locking a beam onto a target and holding it there for 7s, pulsing in place and grinding everything beneath it. (V) Supernova — tap to detonate instantly, or HOLD to overheat: you slow, take far less damage, drag everything inward, then blow it all outward and release a vastly larger nova. (G) Supermassive — two black holes orbit you swallowing regular mobs whole (bosses are too heavy to lift), and it STACKS to five pairs.
Cleaver 🔪
Cursed cleaving arcs
A heavy butcher's blade trailing cursed red energy. Each swing throws a pair of crossing crescent arcs that fly outward and CUT THROUGH several enemies before fading, so lining foes up in a row shreds the whole line. Fast, aggressive and close-to-mid range. (Z) Dismantle — opens a killing zone at your cursor that fills with 20 slashes landing at random points inside it. (X) Rend — one colossal cross-cut catches everything inside its radius, and anything already below 20% HP is severed outright. (C) Abattoir — a domain blooms around you for 7s carving everything inside several times a second, multiplying your defense by 1.4, feeding you health on kills, and growing wider and stronger with every cut it lands. (V) Guillotine — lunge at your cursor cleaving the lane you tear through, then land one colossal overhead stroke for the biggest single hit in the kit.

INFO & CONTROLS

HOW TO PLAY

You're dropped into an endless arena and the goal is simple: survive. Pick a weapon, then move with WASD (or the arrow keys), aim with your mouse, and hold or click to fire. Enemies pour in wave after wave, and each one you kill drops XP. Collect enough and you level up mid-run, which lets you pick a buff — more damage, faster attacks, extra defense, life steal, whatever fits your build. There's no single "right" choice; part of the fun is stacking buffs that turn your weapon into something ridiculous.

The longer you last, the nastier it gets. Tougher enemies and minibosses show up every 5 waves as you climb, and at wave 50 the time-lord Kronax — a true multi-phase boss — arrives. Keep moving, use your dash to slip out of bad spots, and don't get greedy chasing kills into a corner. When you eventually go down, the iCoins you earned that run are yours to keep — spend them in the iCoin Shop on permanent upgrades and unlocks that make your next run stronger. Minibosses can even drop rare crates containing weapon skins. Die, upgrade, and come back harder. That's the loop.

CONTROLS

WASD / Arrows: Move

Mouse: Aim

Click: Attack

Z: Weapon Ability (when your weapon has one) or Dash

Dash, Ability, and Game Speed keys can be changed in Settings → Keybinds
